reference_question: Summarize the key information in this document.
user_question: Can you provide a summary of the key information in this document?
answer: This is a Newport Event Survey for the Detroit Grand Prix held on June 11, 1995, with R.L. Lavoie as the Detroit-MCA Division Manager. The event had 124,000 attendees, with 18 people (8 corporate, 8 retail, 2 employees) attending the Newport hospitality tent. While the hospitality tent received excellent ratings for food, cleanliness, and service, invitees reported difficulty locating it since the Indy Lights Paddock area was not clearly identified. The main recommendation is to specify the hospitality tent location on future invitations. No promotional materials (mugs, posters, displays) were used at the event.
